# country-flag-icons vendored dependency

- Package: `country-flag-icons`
- Version: `1.6.20`
- Upstream repository: <https://gitlab.com/catamphetamine/country-flag-icons>
- Upstream commit: `3b8ea50f08ab9d5e79c90325ff76606a4258a719`
- Registry archive: `country-flag-icons-1.6.20.tgz`
- License: MIT (see `1.6.20/LICENSE`)

The checked-in registry archive is the application dependency used by
`apps/web/package.json`. The extracted `1.6.20` directory is retained as an
auditable runtime source and SVG snapshot. Builds therefore do not need the
upstream package or repository to remain available.

To update this dependency, review the upstream release and license, replace
both the archive and extracted snapshot, update the checksum and metadata in
this file, refresh `package-lock.json`, then run the web build and image build.
